text:
Nora: throwing a different idea into the ring for sidebar regroup deep-links: instead of auto-expanding and potentially disrupting layout, what if we show a transient 'peek' overlay that points to the hidden item in the collapsed nav? preserves manual state but still gives orientation.
Gus: interesting. So the nav doesn't change structure unless the user interacts, but we still make the linked item discoverable visually. how would screen readers know about it?
Ivy: for SRs we could expose an aria-live message like: 'Linked item available in sidebar preview. Press P to pin and open the section.' Keep the overlay purely visual for sighted users but provide a keyboard affordance for assistive users.
Sam: UX caveat: overlays are easy to miss on small viewports. On mobile maybe we should fall back to inline expansion because there's less lateral space for a peek. Desktop: peek overlay. Mobile: expand.
Nora: good call on viewport. Also idea: overlay includes a tiny CTA: 'Open in nav (P)' where P is a keyboard shortcut. pressing P expands the group and moves focus into the item.
Gus: keyboard flow I'd expect to test: Land on page -> overlay appears (non-modal) -> Tab sequences should not trap inside overlay -> hitting P expands nav and focuses target with preventScroll. ensure we use tabindex=-1 on the target for programmatic focus.
Ivy: a11y details: aria-live polite message only when arriving from an external referrer, to avoid noise for internal app transitions. The overlay should be accessible via aria-describedby on the nav toggle. Also expose an offscreen 'Preview shown' message so SR users get the same context.
Sam: routing note: keep canonical path structure (/workspaces/:id/.../:itemId). Router mount should not auto-toggle nav open state. Instead it triggers the preview overlay for external loads. We can include a small session flag to avoid repeat previews if the user already saw it.
Nora: copy for overlay: 'Linked: Models ▪ Model ABC — Press P to open in sidebar' with an Undo/Close 'x'. Keep it low-contrast and dismissible.
Gus: animation & motion: animate overlay fade-in 180ms and respect prefers-reduced-motion. If user chooses to 'Pin' (P), then animate the nav expansion with a 120ms slide.
Ivy: SR announcement suggestion: aria-live text = 'Sidebar preview: Models revealed in preview. Press P to open. Press Escape to dismiss.' Also update breadcrumbs aria-label for consistency.
Sam: edge cases: if user previously collapsed the group, we do NOT override on initial preview. If they press P, we open and record their manual choice in localStorage for that workspace. If they manually toggle later, update the stored preference.
DevBot: created ticket UX-760 "sidebar preview overlay for deep-links" and linked A11Y-711 for SR announcement checks.
A11yBot: added automated test steps: (1) external deep-link shows aria-live preview (external only), (2) pressing P expands group + focus with preventScroll, (3) overlay is dismissible and does not trap keyboard, (4) mobile falls back to inline expansion.
Nora: action items: (1) prototype overlay + P shortcut (Nora), (2) aria-live messaging and SR copy (Ivy), (3) mobile fallback rules + reduced-motion variants (Sam), (4) persistence of manual toggles in localStorage + undo affordance (Gus), (5) add a11y tests and e2e (A11yBot). I'll add a tiny Figma microflow and a short screen recording showing both preview and the P->pin flow. tagging @Gus @Ivy @Sam @A11yBot @DevBot :sparkles:
